part.text: {"items":[{"index":1,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"spend compute on members drawn from different training seeds or checkpoints, so extra compute buys a different distribution rather than more samples of the same one","reason":"Shifts axis from member count to model diversity; compute then buys a different distribution, not more samples of the same one."},{"index":2,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"Change the measured quantity to one whose rarity scales with the compute: the error of the ensemble-implied return level at fixed physical thresholds","reason":"Replaces fixed-percentile scores with return-level error at fixed thresholds, so added members buy access to rarer, still-accurate events."},{"index":3,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"reallocate the same budget from 1,000 members x 7 dates to ~100-200 members x 40-60 dates, and run members in sequential batches with a stopping rule once the slope's sign is resolved","reason":"Swaps compute axis to dates and reorders runs with a stopping rule; compute buys slope detectability, not undetectable member gains."}]}
